# Hold Card

> Put the wait in writing when the client holds the timeline. A browser tool for independent designers, developers, and consultants blocked waiting on client feedback, assets, or approvals.

Hold Card turns a client-side delay into a sendable email and a one-page PDF hold note. Paste the project, what you need, and days waiting. First, second, or last polite hold. Firm or polite. Nothing is uploaded. It stays in the browser.

This is not a contract rewrite. Not legal advice. Not a penalty notice.

Scope Card is the sibling for before the job. That's Extra is the sibling for after the extra ask. Still Due is the sibling for unpaid invoices.
